_comment: Single source of truth for deployment-specific values. Change these, re-run `npm run build`, and every canonical URL, Open Graph tag, sitemap entry and JSON-LD node updates together.
_siteUrl_help: Absolute origin, no trailing slash. For a GitHub Pages USER site this is https://<username>.github.io. For a project site it is still https://<username>.github.io (the repo name goes in basePath). For a custom domain, e.g. https://rohanbasava.com.
_basePath_help: Leave empty for a user site or custom domain served at the root. For a GitHub Pages PROJECT site served at https://<username>.github.io/<repo>/, set this to "/<repo>" (leading slash, no trailing slash).
_formspreeId_help: Your Formspree form ID only, not the full URL. Create a free form at https://formspree.io, then copy the ID out of the endpoint it gives you: for https://formspree.io/f/abcdwxyz the ID is "abcdwxyz". While this is empty the contact form falls back to opening the visitor's email client with the message pre-filled.
